title: Super Bowl 2026 field invader reveals first-person video of hectic scene

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Super Bowl 2026 field invader reveals first-person video of hectic scene
sources.description: The individual, identified as Alex González, 25, ran onto the field during the fourth quarter without a shirt on as he dodged security guards and Patriots rookie wide receiver Kyle Williams, before sliding to allow himself to be taken in on Sunday.
